title: Load
blurb: Reading instrument exports and ROIs into AnnData.

items.name: read_metabolomics_data
items.doc: Load a single spatial metabolomics file into an AnnData object.
items.sig: read_metabolomics_data(file_path: 'str') -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: load_from_folder
items.doc: Scan a folder for spatial metabolomics files, auto-pair tissue and background files by name, and return a list of AnnData objects.
items.sig: load_from_folder(folder_path: 'str') -> 'List[ad.AnnData]'

items.name: load_annotation_scores
items.doc: Merge per-compound annotation confidence scores from a separate feature table into ``adata.var[target_col]``.
items.sig: load_annotation_scores(adata: 'ad.AnnData', feature_table_path: 'str', compound_col: 'str' = 'Compound', score_col: 'str' = 'Identification Score', target_col: 'str' = 'score') -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: check_rois
items.doc: Verify that every AnnData in the list has ROI labels assigned.
items.sig: check_rois(adatas: 'List[ad.AnnData]') -> 'None'

items.name: save_spatial_data
items.doc: Save a list of processed AnnData objects to disk as ``.h5ad`` files.
items.sig: save_spatial_data(adatas: 'List[ad.AnnData]', output_dir: 'str' = '.', prefix: 'str' = 'mortis_sample') -> 'List[Path]'

items.name: draw_ROIs
items.doc: Single-window interactive ROI selector. User draws Tissue (Green) -> Clicks Confirm -> Draws Background (White) -> Clicks Confirm.
items.sig: draw_ROIs(adata: anndata._core.anndata.AnnData) -> anndata._core.anndata.AnnData

items.name: draw_ROIs_for_folder
items.sig: draw_ROIs_for_folder(adatas: List[anndata._core.anndata.AnnData]) -> List[anndata._core.anndata.AnnData]

title: Clean
blurb: Removing background, low-confidence annotations and drug compounds.

items.name: filter_background
items.sig: filter_background(adatas: 'List[ad.AnnData]', cutoff: 'float' = 1.5, mode: 'str' = 'sample') -> 'Tuple[List[ad.AnnData], List[dict]]'

items.name: filter_by_score
items.doc: Keep only metabolites whose annotation confidence score meets a minimum threshold.
items.sig: filter_by_score(adata: 'ad.AnnData', min_score: 'float' = 0.3, score_col: 'str' = 'score', copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: filter_drugs
items.doc: Remove drug metabolites using the DrugBank database.
items.sig: filter_drugs(adata: 'ad.AnnData', db_path: 'Optional[str]' = None, remove_all: 'bool' = True, drug_names: 'Optional[List[str]]' = None, copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: list_drug_matches
items.doc: Return a DataFrame of metabolites found in DrugBank, without removing them.
items.sig: list_drug_matches(adata: 'ad.AnnData', db_path: 'Optional[str]' = None) -> 'pd.DataFrame'

items.name: tic_normalize
items.doc: Total Ion Current (TIC) normalization. Scales row sums to the median TIC (or a target_sum) to preserve log1p effectiveness.
items.sig: tic_normalize(adata: 'ad.AnnData', target_sum: 'Optional[float]' = None, copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: median_normalize
items.doc: Median-intensity normalization.
items.sig: median_normalize(adata: 'ad.AnnData', target_value: 'Optional[float]' = None, copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: log1p_transform
items.sig: log1p_transform(adata: 'ad.AnnData', copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: scale
items.sig: scale(adata: 'ad.AnnData', max_value: 'Optional[float]' = 10.0, copy: 'bool' = False, **kwargs) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: run_pca
items.doc: Principal Component Analysis with automatic GPU hardware acceleration.
items.sig: run_pca(adata: 'ad.AnnData', n_comps: 'int' = 50, random_state: 'int' = 0, use_hardware: 'bool' = True, copy: 'bool' = False, **kwargs) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: run_neighbors
items.doc: Compute nearest-neighbor graph, default to cosine metric for MSI.
items.sig: run_neighbors(adata: 'ad.AnnData', n_neighbors: 'int' = 30, n_pcs: 'int' = 30, metric: 'str' = 'cosine', random_state: 'int' = 0, copy: 'bool' = False, **kwargs) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: run_umap
items.sig: run_umap(adata: 'ad.AnnData', min_dist: 'float' = 0.3, spread: 'float' = 1.0, random_state: 'int' = 0, use_hardware: 'bool' = True, copy: 'bool' = False, **kwargs) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: preprocess
items.doc: Full preprocessing pipeline with toggles for already-processed data: row normalization → log1p → (optional) scale → PCA → kNN graph.
items.sig: preprocess(adata: 'ad.AnnData', n_pcs: 'int' = 50, n_pcs_neighbors: 'int' = 10, n_neighbors: 'int' = 15, metric: 'str' = 'euclidean', do_tic: 'bool' = True, normalize_method: 'str' = 'tic', do_log1p: 'bool' = True, target_sum: 'Optional[float]' = None, scale_data: 'bool' = False, max_value: 'float' = 10.0, random_state: 'int' = 0, use_hardware: 'bool' = True, copy: 'bool' = False, **kwargs) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: correct_batches
items.doc: Batch correction with ComBat.
items.sig: correct_batches(adata: 'ad.AnnData', batch_key: 'str' = 'sample', covariates: 'Optional[List[str]]' = None, recompute_pca: 'bool' = True, use_hardware: 'bool' = True, copy: 'bool' = False, **kwargs) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: run_harmony
items.doc: Batch-correct the PCA embedding using Harmony (Korsunsky et al. 2019, Nat Methods).
items.sig: run_harmony(adata: 'ad.AnnData', batch_key: 'str' = 'sample', adjusted_basis: 'str' = 'X_pca_harmony', copy: 'bool' = False, **kwargs) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: batch_mixing_score
items.doc: Local Inverse Simpson's Index (LISI; Korsunsky et al. 2019, the Harmony paper) — verifies whether batch correction (:func:`run_harmony`, :func:`correct_batches`) actually worked, rather than assuming it did.
items.sig: batch_mixing_score(adata: 'ad.AnnData', batch_key: 'str' = 'sample', use_rep: 'str' = 'X_pca', n_neighbors: 'int' = 30, copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'ad.AnnData'

title: Segment
blurb: Clustering pixels into chemical clusters and spatial domains.

items.name: cluster
items.doc: Leiden clustering supporting single or multiple resolutions for exploration.
items.sig: cluster(adata: 'ad.AnnData', resolution: 'Union[float, List[float]]' = 0.5, key_added: 'str' = 'cluster', random_state: 'int' = 0, copy: 'bool' = False, **kwargs) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: cluster_nmf
items.doc: Non-negative Matrix Factorisation (NMF) clustering with NVIDIA GPU Dispatch.
items.sig: cluster_nmf(adata: 'ad.AnnData', n_components: 'int' = 10, key_added: 'str' = 'nmf_cluster', basis_key: 'str' = 'X_nmf', random_state: 'int' = 0, max_iter: 'int' = 500, use_hardware: 'bool' = True, copy: 'bool' = False, **kwargs) -> 'Tuple[ad.AnnData, pd.DataFrame]'

items.name: spatial_domains
items.doc: Spatially-aware clustering into contiguous tissue domains ("niches").
items.sig: spatial_domains(adata: 'ad.AnnData', resolution: 'float' = 0.5, alpha: 'float' = 0.5, n_neighbors: 'int' = 6, batch_key: 'str' = 'sample', key_added: 'str' = 'domain', random_state: 'int' = 0, copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: spatial_domains_kmeans
items.doc: Fast, fixed-k alternative to :func:`spatial_domains`.
items.sig: spatial_domains_kmeans(adata: 'ad.AnnData', n_domains: 'int' = 8, alpha: 'float' = 0.5, n_neighbors: 'int' = 6, batch_key: 'str' = 'sample', key_added: 'str' = 'domain_kmeans', random_state: 'int' = 0, copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: rename_clusters
items.sig: rename_clusters(adata: 'ad.AnnData', mapping: 'Dict[str, str]', cluster_key: 'str' = 'cluster') -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: cluster_validation
items.doc: Silhouette score (scikit-learn) for an existing clustering: how well separated the clusters are in ``use_rep`` space, in [-1, 1] (higher = better separated). Standard scanpy-adjacent QC for choosing/reporting a Leiden resolution or comparing clustering methods.
items.sig: cluster_validation(adata: 'ad.AnnData', cluster_key: 'str' = 'cluster', use_rep: 'str' = 'X_pca', sample_size: 'Optional[int]' = 10000, random_state: 'int' = 0) -> 'float'

items.name: compare_clusterings
items.doc: Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) and Adjusted Mutual Information (AMI) between two cluster label assignments of the same pixels — e.g. comparing a Leiden resolution sweep for stability (``adata.obs['cluster_0.3']`` vs. ``adata.obs['cluster_0.5']``), or two independent runs/samples. Both scores are 1.0 for identical labelings and ~0 for random/independent labelings; unlike raw accuracy, both are invariant to how cluster IDs are permuted/renamed.
items.sig: compare_clusterings(labels_a: 'Union[List, np.ndarray, pd.Series]', labels_b: 'Union[List, np.ndarray, pd.Series]') -> 'Dict[str, float]'

items.name: spatially_weighted_nmf
items.doc: Smooths data across physical neighbors before NMF with GPU hardware dispatch.
items.sig: spatially_weighted_nmf(adata: 'ad.AnnData', n_components: 'int' = 10, alpha: 'float' = 0.5, n_neighbors: 'int' = 6, batch_key: 'str' = 'sample', random_state: 'int' = 0, use_hardware: 'bool' = True, copy: 'bool' = False, **kwargs) -> 'Tuple[ad.AnnData, pd.DataFrame]'

items.name: unmix_pixels
items.doc: Non-negative least squares (NNLS) unmixing of mixed pixels against a library of known reference spectra — recovers, per pixel, the non-negative mixing fractions that best reconstruct its intensities as a combination of the references. MSI pixels routinely contain mixed signal from more than one underlying tissue/cell population (unlike single-cell data), so this is a standard MSI-specific analysis category (related to multivariate curve resolution) when reference spectra are known a priori.
items.sig: unmix_pixels(adata: 'ad.AnnData', reference_spectra: 'Dict[str, Dict[str, float]]', copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: run_paga
items.sig: run_paga(adata: 'ad.AnnData', cluster_key: 'str' = 'cluster', copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'ad.AnnData'

title: Test
blurb: Sample-level statistics. Pixels are not replicates.

items.name: pseudobulk
items.doc: Collapse pixels to one profile per sample — the required first step before any comparison between groups of samples.
items.sig: pseudobulk(adata: 'ad.AnnData', sample_key: 'str', method: 'str' = 'mean', layer: 'Optional[str]' = None, min_pixels: 'int' = 10, carry_obs: 'Optional[Sequence[str]]' = None) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: differential_abundance
items.doc: Compare two groups of samples, one metabolite at a time, at the sample level.
items.sig: differential_abundance(adata: 'ad.AnnData', group_key: 'str', group1: 'str', group2: 'str', layer: 'Optional[str]' = None, min_samples: 'int' = 3, bootstrap: 'int' = 0, alpha: 'float' = 0.05, random_state: 'int' = 0) -> 'pd.DataFrame'

items.name: paired_differential_abundance
items.doc: Within-subject change between two timepoints, on matched samples.
items.sig: paired_differential_abundance(adata: 'ad.AnnData', pair_key: 'str', time_key: 'str', time1: 'str', time2: 'str', layer: 'Optional[str]' = None, min_pairs: 'int' = 3, random_state: 'int' = 0) -> 'pd.DataFrame'

items.name: cliffs_delta
items.doc: Cliff's delta between two groups, computed per column.
items.sig: cliffs_delta(group1: 'np.ndarray', group2: 'np.ndarray') -> 'np.ndarray'

items.name: find_markers
items.sig: find_markers(adata: 'ad.AnnData', cluster_key: 'str' = 'cluster', method: 'str' = 'wilcoxon', n_top: 'int' = 20, copy: 'bool' = False, **kwargs) -> 'Tuple[ad.AnnData, pd.DataFrame]'

items.name: compare_groups
items.doc: Compare two groups of **pixels** within a single sample.
items.sig: compare_groups(adata: 'ad.AnnData', groupby: 'str', group1: 'str', group2: 'str', method: 'str' = 'wilcoxon', copy: 'bool' = False, acknowledge_pixel_level: 'bool' = False) -> 'Tuple[ad.AnnData, pd.DataFrame]'

items.name: multi_group_test
items.sig: multi_group_test(adata: 'ad.AnnData', groupby: 'str', method: 'str' = 'kruskal', copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'Tuple[ad.AnnData, pd.DataFrame]'

title: Space
blurb: Where things are, not just how much.

items.name: spatial_autocorrelation
items.doc: Global spatial autocorrelation for every metabolite: Moran's I and Geary's C (analogous to squidpy's ``spatial_autocorr(mode=...)``, computed together here since both reuse the same spatial weights).
items.sig: spatial_autocorrelation(adata: 'ad.AnnData', n_neighbors: 'int' = 6, batch_key: 'str' = 'sample', use_fdr: 'bool' = False, copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'Tuple[ad.AnnData, pd.DataFrame]'

items.name: spatial_de
items.sig: spatial_de(adata: 'ad.AnnData', n_top: 'int' = 50, n_neighbors: 'int' = 6, use_fdr: 'bool' = False, copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'Tuple[ad.AnnData, pd.DataFrame]'

items.name: local_moran
items.doc: Local Moran's I (LISA, Anselin 1995) for one metabolite: a per-pixel score saying whether a pixel sits inside a patch of similar values, or stands out against its neighbours.
items.sig: local_moran(adata: 'ad.AnnData', metabolite: 'str', n_neighbors: 'int' = 6, batch_key: 'str' = 'sample', copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'Tuple[ad.AnnData, pd.DataFrame]'

items.name: getis_ord_gi
items.doc: Getis-Ord Gi* hotspot statistic (Getis & Ord 1992, 1995) for one metabolite: a per-pixel z-score testing whether a pixel *and its neighbours* (self included, unlike LISA) form a statistically significant high-value ("hot spot") or low-value ("cold spot") cluster.
items.sig: getis_ord_gi(adata: 'ad.AnnData', metabolite: 'str', n_neighbors: 'int' = 6, batch_key: 'str' = 'sample', copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'Tuple[ad.AnnData, pd.DataFrame]'

items.name: spatial_neighbors
items.sig: spatial_neighbors(adata: 'ad.AnnData', n_neighbors: 'int' = 6, batch_key: 'str' = 'sample', copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: neighborhood_enrichment
items.doc: n_jobs : int or None, optional Threads used by the Numba-JIT permutation loop. Default: ``None``, which uses the ``MORTIS_N_JOBS`` environment variable (or all CPU cores if unset). Unlike ``os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS']``-style settings, ``numba.set_num_threads()`` genuinely takes effect at call time, so this parameter is not just cosmetic.
items.sig: neighborhood_enrichment(adata: 'ad.AnnData', cluster_key: 'str' = 'cluster', n_permutations: 'int' = 1000, n_jobs: 'Optional[int]' = None, random_state: 'int' = 0, copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'Tuple[ad.AnnData, pd.DataFrame]'

items.name: co_occurrence
items.doc: Distance-binned co-occurrence probability between cluster/domain labels (analogous to squidpy's ``gr.co_occurrence``), distinct from :func:`neighborhood_enrichment`: this uses continuous physical distance bins rather than a fixed-degree graph, so it reveals *at what distance scale* two regions tend to co-occur, not just whether they're adjacent.
items.sig: co_occurrence(adata: 'ad.AnnData', cluster_key: 'str' = 'cluster', n_bins: 'int' = 25, max_dist: 'Optional[float]' = None, batch_key: 'str' = 'sample', copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'pd.DataFrame'

items.name: spatial_gradient
items.sig: spatial_gradient(adata: 'ad.AnnData', target_col: 'str', target_val: 'str', batch_key: 'str' = 'sample', bins: 'int' = 15, max_dist: 'float' = 1000.0) -> 'pd.DataFrame'

items.name: metabolite_colocalization
items.doc: Pairwise ion-image similarity network among the top-``top_n`` spatially variable metabolites (run :func:`spatial_autocorrelation` first).
items.sig: metabolite_colocalization(adata: 'ad.AnnData', top_n: 'int' = 50, corr_threshold: 'float' = 0.4, use_spatial_smooth: 'bool' = True, metric: 'str' = 'pearson') -> 'pd.DataFrame'

items.name: diversity_index
items.doc: Per-pixel metabolomic diversity/heterogeneity score, treating each pixel's (non-negative) intensities as a compositional distribution over metabolites — an ecology-style diversity index applied to chemistry instead of species counts.
items.sig: diversity_index(adata: 'ad.AnnData', method: 'str' = 'shannon', copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: cluster_diversity
items.doc: Region-level heterogeneity: diversity of cluster/domain *composition* within each group (e.g. sample or condition) — how mixed vs. homogeneous each sample's tissue-domain makeup is, complementing the per-pixel :func:`diversity_index`.
items.sig: cluster_diversity(adata: 'ad.AnnData', cluster_key: 'str' = 'cluster', groupby: 'str' = 'sample', method: 'str' = 'shannon') -> 'pd.DataFrame'

title: Organise
blurb: Differential spatial organization: same amount, different arrangement.

items.name: spatial_organization
items.doc: Summarise each metabolite's spatial pattern, once per sample.
items.sig: spatial_organization(adata: 'ad.AnnData', sample_key: 'str', metrics: 'Sequence[str]' = ('morans_i', 'entropy', 'hotspot_fraction', 'gini'), n_neighbors: 'int' = 6, layer: 'Optional[str]' = None, min_pixels: 'int' = 50, carry_obs: 'Optional[Sequence[str]]' = None) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: differential_spatial_organization
items.doc: Test whether metabolites are arranged differently between two groups.
items.sig: differential_spatial_organization(org: 'ad.AnnData', group_key: 'str', group1: 'str', group2: 'str', metric: 'str' = 'morans_i', min_samples: 'int' = 3, bootstrap: 'int' = 0, random_state: 'int' = 0) -> 'pd.DataFrame'

items.name: compare_abundance_and_organization
items.doc: Join the two axes and label what actually moved for each metabolite.
items.sig: compare_abundance_and_organization(abundance: 'pd.DataFrame', organization: 'pd.DataFrame', delta_threshold: 'float' = 0.474, fdr_threshold: 'Optional[float]' = 0.05) -> 'pd.DataFrame'

items.name: cross_cohort_profile
items.doc: Do two cohorts show the *same* signature? Typically: two drugs.
items.sig: cross_cohort_profile(result_a: 'pd.DataFrame', result_b: 'pd.DataFrame', labels: 'Tuple[str, str]' = ('cohort_a', 'cohort_b'), effect_col: 'str' = 'delta', min_shared: 'int' = 10, n_boot: 'int' = 0, random_state: 'int' = 0) -> 'Tuple[float, pd.DataFrame]'

items.name: track_flow
items.doc: Does a signature *persist* over treatment, flip, or reorganise?
items.sig: track_flow(baseline: 'pd.DataFrame', on_treatment: 'pd.DataFrame', labels: 'Tuple[str, str]' = ('baseline', 'on_treatment'), effect_col: 'str' = 'delta', min_shared: 'int' = 10, n_boot: 'int' = 0, random_state: 'int' = 0) -> 'Tuple[float, pd.DataFrame]'

items.name: compare_signatures
items.doc: Correlate the per-metabolite effect sizes of two independent analyses.
items.sig: compare_signatures(result_a: 'pd.DataFrame', result_b: 'pd.DataFrame', effect_col: 'str' = 'delta', labels: 'Tuple[str, str]' = ('a', 'b'), min_shared: 'int' = 10, n_boot: 'int' = 0, random_state: 'int' = 0) -> 'Tuple[float, float, pd.DataFrame]'

title: Annotate
blurb: Chemical class, enrichment and KEGG pathways.

items.name: classify_compounds
items.doc: Assign a chemical class to every compound from its name.
items.sig: classify_compounds(adata: 'ad.AnnData', key_added: 'str' = 'chemical_class', reference: 'Optional[Union[pd.DataFrame, Dict[str, str]]]' = None, overrides: 'Optional[Dict[str, str]]' = None, copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: classification_report

items.name: class_enrichment

items.name: pathway_ora

items.name: map_compound_ids
items.doc: Resolve compound names to database identifiers via MetaboAnalyst.
items.sig: map_compound_ids(names: 'Sequence[str]', cache: 'Optional[str]' = None, timeout: 'float' = 60.0, retries: 'int' = 2) -> 'pd.DataFrame'

items.name: fetch_kegg_pathway_sets
items.doc: Build ``{pathway_name: [KEGG compound ids]}`` from the KEGG REST API.
items.sig: fetch_kegg_pathway_sets(kegg_ids: 'Optional[Sequence[str]]' = None, cache: 'Optional[str]' = None, timeout: 'float' = 60.0, retries: 'int' = 2, metabolic_only: 'bool' = True) -> 'Dict[str, List[str]]'

items.name: annotate_pathways
items.doc: Name to identifier to pathway enrichment, in one call.
items.sig: annotate_pathways(adata: 'ad.AnnData', result: 'pd.DataFrame', cache: 'Optional[str]' = None, delta_threshold: 'float' = 0.474, fdr_threshold: 'Optional[float]' = None, direction: 'bool' = True, min_size: 'int' = 3, key_added: 'str' = 'compound_ids', timeout: 'float' = 60.0, retries: 'int' = 2) -> 'Tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]'

items.name: clear_cache
items.doc: Delete cached API responses. Returns how many files were removed.
items.sig: clear_cache(cache: 'Optional[str]' = None) -> 'int'

items.name: score_metabolite_set
items.sig: score_metabolite_set(adata: 'ad.AnnData', metabolites: 'List[str]', score_name: 'str' = 'metabolite_set_score', copy: 'bool' = False) -> 'ad.AnnData'

items.name: metabolite_set_enrichment
items.sig: metabolite_set_enrichment(results_df: 'pd.DataFrame', metabolite_sets: 'Dict[str, List[str]]', score_col: 'str' = 'log2fc', min_set_size: 'int' = 3, n_permutations: 'int' = 1000, random_state: 'int' = 0) -> 'pd.DataFrame'

items.name: lipid_class_summary
items.sig: lipid_class_summary(adata: 'ad.AnnData', groupby: 'Optional[str]' = None) -> 'pd.DataFrame'

title: Plot
blurb: Publication figures with editable-vector PDF export.

items.name: set_publication_style
items.doc: Apply the house style to every subsequent figure.
items.sig: set_publication_style(latex: 'bool' = False, font_family: 'str' = 'sans-serif', base_size: 'float' = 8.0, linewidth: 'float' = 0.8, dpi: 'int' = 300, theme: 'str' = 'print') -> 'None'

items.name: reset_style
items.doc: Restore matplotlib's settings from before the first style call.
items.sig: reset_style() -> 'None'

items.name: save_figure
items.doc: Write a figure in one or more formats, with provenance in the PDF metadata.
items.sig: save_figure(fig: 'plt.Figure', path: 'Union[str, Path]', formats: 'Sequence[str]' = ('pdf',), provenance: 'Optional[Dict[str, Any]]' = None, close: 'bool' = False) -> 'Dict[str, Path]'

items.name: plot_ion_images
